name: Astribot
summary:
Astribot (Xingchen Intelligence) was founded in Shenzhen in late 2022. Our vision is for billions of people to have AI robot assistants, and our mission is to promote human–robot coexistence, co-creation and shared success.
The company pioneered an integrated hardware and software architecture called Design for AI (DFAI), closely combining AI intelligence with advanced manipulation. Breakthroughs in acquiring embodied AI data allow robots to learn, think and work like people, interact smoothly and intelligently, use human tools and equipment, and help people complete tedious, difficult or dangerous tasks. These capabilities form its distinctive technical strengths.
